english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken quantifier for a large amount or for “much of” when the thing being measured is understood.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a large indefinite number of people or things, including when it stands alone as “many.”

examples.english: I drank much more water than usual.
examples.traditional: 我飲咗好多水，比平時多。
